talents.e: Lengthens Gouge's effect by 1.5 seconds at full rank.
Killing a tough foe boosts crit on your next few strikes for 20 seconds.
Raises critical strike chance for all attacks and Poisons by 5%.
Finishing moves have a 60% chance to add a combo point.
Increases damage against Humanoid and Giant enemies by 4%.
Slice and Dice lasts 45% longer.
Finishing moves can restore Energy for each combo point spent.
Cuts Expose Armor's Energy cost and refunds two combo points at five.
Adds 20% to the critical damage bonus of several strikes.
Boosts Poison damage by 20% and adds dispel resistance to Poisons.
Next qualifying attack, including Mutilate, gains 100% extra crit chance.
Raises Poison application chance by 10% and sometimes saves a charge.
Increases maximum Energy by 10.
Strikes with both weapons for bonus damage on Poisoned targets, awarding two combo points.
Stunned enemies take 10% more damage from your Poisons and attacks.
Combo-generating critical strikes always add an extra combo point.
Finisher boosts Poison damage by 30% and application chance by 10% for up to 21 seconds.
Eviscerate deals 20% more damage at full rank.
Reduces the Energy cost of Sinister Strike by 5.
Increases dodge chance by 5%.
Raises Backstab crit by 30%, Mutilate crit by 15%, and adds combo point chances.
Increases parry chance by 6%.
Increases chance to hit by 3%.
Cuts Sprint and Evasion cooldowns by 60%.
After a parry, counterstrike for extra damage and disarm the target for 6 seconds.
Sprint always removes all movement-impairing effects when activated.
Kick always silences the target for 2 seconds.
Reduces the Energy cost of Eviscerate by 10.
Increases off-hand weapon damage by 25%.
Boosts melee attack speed and cleaves one extra nearby enemy for 15 seconds.
Weapon-dependent bonus: extra attack, crit chance, or armor ignored.
Reduces chance for your attacks to be dodged or parried by 2%.
Increases Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate damage by 6%.
Doubles Energy regeneration for 15 seconds on a five-minute cooldown.
Cuts Stealth's speed penalty by 15% and its cooldown by 6 seconds.
Stealth detection works as if you were three levels higher.
Increases Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate damage by 10%.
Dodging an attack or fully resisting a spell guarantees a combo point.
Reduces Vanish and Blind cooldowns by 90 seconds.
Halves the Energy cost of Sap and Blind.
Increases Ambush critical strike chance by 45%.
Ambush, Garrote, and Cheap Shot always add an extra combo point.
Strike deals more damage with a Dagger, boosts dodge, and adds a combo point.
Widens Distract radius by 5 yards and lowers distracted enemies' detection further.
Stealth detection as if three levels higher, and 4% fewer spell and ranged hits.
Adds two combo points to your target with a 20-second window to use them.
Ignores 9% of armor and boosts Rupture damage by 30%.
Cuts Cheap Shot and Garrote Energy costs by 20, and Garrote works from any angle.
Immediately resets the cooldowns of your other Rogue abilities.
Instant strike that makes the target take more Rupture damage from you.
Deals 10% more damage with Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage on low-health foes.
Backstab gives a 15% chance that the next Ambush skips Stealth.
Rupture ticks cut the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab, stacking five times.
